faqs.question: What appliances do you repair?
faqs.answer: Appliance Helpers connects you with technicians who handle repairs on major household appliances — refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, ovens, ranges, cooktops, freezers, ice makers, microwaves, garbage disposals, and more.

faqs.question: Can I get same-day appliance repair?
faqs.answer: Same-day and next-day appointments are frequently available, depending on technician availability in your area. Call {{phone}} and we'll find you the earliest opening nearby.

faqs.question: Do you repair all appliance brands?
faqs.answer: Yes. The independent technicians in our network service nearly every major appliance brand and model — including Whirlpool, GE, Samsung, LG, Maytag, KitchenAid, Bosch, Frigidaire, Kenmore, and many more.

faqs.question: How does scheduling work?
faqs.answer: Call {{phone}} and tell us about your appliance and the issue — we'll connect you with a local technician. They'll diagnose the problem in your home, walk you through the fix, and quote you before any work starts.

faqs.question: Will I know the price before work begins?
faqs.answer: Yes. You'll get an up-front quote once the technician diagnoses the problem, and no work begins until you approve it — there's never any obligation to continue.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: We have local technicians on standby in {{geoArea}}, ready to help with your appliance repair needs. Once you call, we'll pair you with a nearby technician as soon as one is available.

faqs.question: How does Appliance Helpers work?
faqs.answer: Appliance Helpers is a free referral service that connects you with independent, local appliance repair technicians. These technicians aren't employed by Appliance Helpers, and it's always your choice whether to move forward once you've received a quote.
